name: task-management-platform
description: Task-management platform with a generic workflow engine and plug-in task types

scripts.start: npm run setup && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.dev: npm install && npm run setup && docker compose up -d --wait postgres redis && docker compose up -d migrate && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend-services/task-service" "npm run dev -w frontend-application/task-app"
